      exact hi

    ∃ (c : ℕ) (h : c = A.rank) (C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin c) ℂ)

  have hr_pos : r ≥ 1 := hc

      A = (L.map (TransvectionStruct.toMatrix : TransvectionStruct (Fin m) ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)).prod * 
          diagonal D * 
          (L'.map (TransvectionStruct.toMatrix : TransvectionStruct (Fin m) ℂ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℂ)).prod :=
    Matrix.Pivot.exists_list_transvec_mul_diagonal_mul_list_transvec A
  
  rcases h_decomp with ⟨L, L', D, hA⟩
  
  -- We'll construct C from the first r columns of the left factor
  -- and R from the first r rows of the right factor
  have h_rank_diag : (diagonal D).rank = r := by
    rw [hA] at hr_def
    have := congr_arg Matrix.rank hA
    rw [hr_def] at this
    -- The rank is preserved under multiplication by invertible matrices
    have h_left : ((L.map TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod).det ≠ 0 := by
      refine Matrix.det_ne_zero_of_isUnit_iff.mpr ?_
      exact isUnit_prod_list_of_isUnit (by
        intro t ht
        rw [List.mem_map] at ht
        rcases ht with ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
        exact TransvectionStruct.det_toMatrix _)
    have h_right : ((L'.map TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod).det ≠ 0 := by
      refine Matrix.det_ne_zero_of_isUnit_iff.mpr ?_
      exact isUnit_prod_list_of_isUnit (by
        intro t ht
        rw [List.mem_map] at ht
        rcases ht with ⟨t', ht', rfl⟩
        exact TransvectionStruct.det_toMatrix _)
    -- Since left and right factors are invertible, rank(A) = rank(diagonal D)
    rw [Matrix.rank_mul_eq_left_of_isUnit_det h_left, 
        Matrix.rank_mul_eq_right_of_isUnit_det h_right] at this
    exact this.symm
  
  -- Count non-zero diagonal entries
  let non_zero_indices : Finset (Fin m) := Finset.filter (fun i => D i ≠ 0) Finset.univ
  have card_non_zero : non_zero_indices.card = r := by
    rw [← Matrix.rank_diagonal]

    ext i j
    simp_rw [C, R, Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_finset_coe]
    calc
      A i j = _ := by rw [hA]
      _ = ∑ k : Fin m, ((L.map TransvectionStruct.toMatrix).prod) i k * D k *
